verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names any GPU model or generation, so it does not show that H100/H200/B200-class or cheaper previous-generation GPUs are offered. It only refers generically to Node Pools of 'different types of Nodes', a 'requested instance type' in Capacity Finder, and on-demand/Spot pricing. That is not enough to credit this story, which is about choosing among specific current and previous GPU generations.
